units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY TRANSPORT WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Transport Worker of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional workers in all modes of urban transport, as well as rail, air, water and road transport, for merits in organising and developing transport operations, increasing production efficiency, improving the use of vehicles, reducing transport costs, improving the quality of transport services and services to the population and organisations, saving materials and fuel, ensuring traffic safety and environmental protection, and developing, creating and introducing new highly efficient equipment and technologies, provided that they have worked in transport in the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY TRANSPORT WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “The honorary title ‘Honorary Transport Worker of the City of…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY TRANSPORT WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: Persons conferred the honorary title ‘Honorary Transport Worker of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award in the amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award is paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.

units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Environmental Protection Worker of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional employees of environmental protection bodies, workers, engineering and technical personnel and office staff of research, design, technological and production organisations and institutions concerned with environmental issues and protection, for merits in conserving natural resources, developing, introducing and mastering resource-saving and environmentally clean technologies, constructing and operating treatment facilities, conserving flora and fauna, and achievements in personnel training, provided that they have worked in environmental protection and rational use of natural resources in the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY STATE SERVICE WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary State Service Worker of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly qualified state servants for merits in organisational work to implement the laws of the City of Moscow and successfully perform the tasks and functions entrusted to the relevant state authorities of the City of Moscow, contributing to improvements in their activities, development of the municipal economy, professional, competent and effective resolution of city-level matters, and protection of citizens’ rights and legitimate interests, provided that they have worked in state authorities, other state bodies of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies of the city for at least 15 years and are serving in the state service of the City of Moscow.

units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Municipal Service Worker of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly qualified municipal servants for merits in developing and ensuring the exercise of the powers of local self-government bodies, improving municipal service, professionally and competently resolving matters of local significance, and protecting citizens’ rights and legitimate interests, provided that they have worked in local self-government bodies and state authorities of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years and are serving in the municipal service of the City of Moscow.
